snippet.title: Treeplanter - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Create and enjoy a peaceful interactive woodland throughout the changing seasons. Piece together groves of trees branch by branch, watch as animals, birds, plants, and insects inhabit your ecosystem, and discover the beauty and wonder of trees!

Each copy of the game sold helps me plant trees, wildflowers, meadows and community orchards, through partnerships with schools, farms, communities and woodland charities. Meaning you’ll help restore real life nature too!! 

Wishlist and find more information here on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531490/Treeplanter

Music by Lucy Gooch from the track 'Rain's Break'
